prerequisites.scope: Complete frozen earlier18k A/B/A/B, including terminal invalid attempts, configuration/leader/raw/archive/analysis and explicit owned cleanup. No earlier failure is reclassified.

campaign.scope: Node-only explicit max park control, A1000000 vsB100000. Same new node artifact; fixed e57 multiplexed load1session/logicalW128/Q64/shared1driver/NAK1000. Driver spin/yield10/5, archive/consensus/service10/20, min1000. All failed attempts retained; no combined-factor or sustained-engine capacity claim.

criteriaScope: Observed stable finite window requires all validationChecks and stabilityChecks true. p99 is reported and optional target attainment is separate; latency is not a default overload criterion. A nonstable valid trial may expose the bounded client/FIFO path rather than the matching engine. No finite trial establishes indefinite capacity; all rounds, failures and invalid generator timing are retained.

groups.scope: Observed finite windows with this client concurrency and bounded queues; no untested-rate, long-run or unconstrained-engine limit claim.

backlog.scope: Non-atomic queue_depth + in_flight observations; not exact queue conservation. Growth is positive OLS trend times observed span in the second half of the arrival window; drain samples excluded.

trials.configurationIdentityScope: Checks completeness and agreement of declared node source/deployment, separate load-generator source/deployment, prepared-state and configuration identities. Missing all load-generator fields means the historical common node/load bundle; any explicit load-generator identity requires all three fields. Artifact bytes and actual node configuration require separate deployment evidence. Rate, worker count and queue size are not inside this fingerprint; grouping additionally separates phase/workers/queue.

fixedLeaderCheck.scope: All recorded CnC samples plus official pre/post list-members views; requires complete collector files from the pre-ready point through post-measurement.
